goal: stronger README-area background and enclosing-frame illusion without claiming host-page overlay authority

segmented-frame.notes: Preserves current content/links and uses removable bridge chrome; continuity is perceptual rather than a literal background layer.

single-table-frame.notes: Closest DOM-level enclosure, but GitHub-owned table CSS, sanitization, padding and responsive behavior must be observed before promotion.

hard_boundaries: No claim of background/overlay outside the README rendering area.
Do not replace factual project/activity content with a flattened decorative mockup.
Do not promote the table experiment before GitHub dark/mobile rendering is observed.
Frame decoration must remain removable without breaking content authority or links.
next_safe_action: Open a draft comparison PR; keep live README on envelope v3 until target rendering evidence favors one v4 candidate.
